title: Great Quality & Super Cute Garden Flag
text: Great Quality & Super Cute Garden Flag. Ordered this for our Holiday decorating this year. I'm going to use it for Christmas thru Valentines Day. Cute gnomes & great quality. Very vibrant colors! Also ordered a Fall/Pumpkin Gnome flag & was impressed with that too. Would Highly Recommend. Fast shipping! A+++
